events.title: Yukihiro Matsumoto releases Ruby 1.0
events.summary: Yukihiro 'Matz' Matsumoto released Ruby 1.0 on December 21, 1996 — crystallizing a language designed for programmer happiness.
events.about: Ruby's expressiveness influenced Rails, Elixir, and modern scripting language design. Matz built a global community from Japan that proved language innovation need not come from Silicon Valley.

narrative.whyChosen: Ruby 1.0 marked Matz's language graduating from personal project to production use.
narrative.whyImportant: It brought an object-oriented scripting alternative to Perl and Python with a distinct philosophy.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers wanted a more human-readable language without sacrificing object-oriented power.
